meta.title: Louhichi Logistics — Your cargo. Our responsibility.
meta.description: International transport mastered from pickup to delivery. Louhichi Logistics: ocean, air, road, customs.

cine.intro1: Your cargo deserves more than simple transport.
cine.intro2: It deserves to be mastered from A to Z.
cine.suivi1: You know where your cargo is.
cine.heroSub: International transport mastered, from pickup to delivery.

services.title: Every link of your supply chain, under one roof.

s1.title: Ocean freight booking
s1.desc: FCL / LCL container freight booked at the best rate, on the main global routes.

s2.title: Customs & formalities
s2.desc: Export/import clearance, declarations, HS codes, full regulatory compliance.

s3.title: Road transport
s3.desc: Pre- and on-carriage, door-to-door delivery throughout Belgium and Europe.

s4.title: Documentary advice
s4.desc: Shipping documents, incoterms, certificates and cargo insurance, no jargon.

s5.title: Traveller ticketing
s5.desc: Flights and long-distance coach tickets at negotiated rates, for you and your teams.

s6.title: DHL drop-off point
s6.desc: Drop your parcels off at Louhichi: we create the label and ship at a negotiated rate.

why.title: Mastery, not a promise.
why.desc: We operate under official accreditations that hold us accountable, at every step of your shipment.

r1.title: A single point of contact
r1.desc: From quote to delivery, the same team follows your file — never an anonymous call centre.

r2.title: Total transparency
r2.desc: Duties, VAT and fees detailed upfront. A firm quote, no surprises on arrival.

r3.title: Trilingual
r3.desc: We work in French, Dutch and English, from the first contact to the last document.

r4.title: Active tracking
r4.desc: You know where your cargo is, at every step of its journey.

m1.title: You choose
m1.desc: Export or import, then the mode of transport.

m2.title: You describe
m2.desc: Ports, goods, containers: a few details are all it takes.

m3.title: We quote
m3.desc: A clear, complete quote within 24 hours.

m4.title: We ship
m4.desc: Booking, customs and transport handled by a single point of contact.

cta.title: Your next shipment deserves to be mastered from end to end.

contact.title: Let's talk about your next shipment.
contact.formSent: Thank you. Our team will get back to you within 24 business hours.
